scope: Red Basin lower storehouse V1.2 closed loading frontage and exterior in the current The Second Bucket placement only. No other well, bench, cart, actors, village, or map approval.
author: Torn Asunder terrain asset author

evidence.godot_context: Matched native Godot hero from actual action ring and cart lane, legal side angle, tactical sector at 110 m and overview. Hero reaches ring, starts real cart movement, and observes three households board at their separate yard until Ready.
evidence.close_up: Native normal and label-free real hero lens checks closed shutter, frame and ground seating. Unobscured native rear corners at same 65° lens are inspection only outside the movement window; no new ability to enter the solid shell.
evidence.reproduction: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility, 1280×720. Open the live Well Road from Raska's second campaign briefing. Use upper staging, west fork, wash entrance and lower staging to reach the exterior ring near XZ (-143,39); press Space as hero and watch the cart move to (-134,41) before all households board. Compare actual hero and Shift/Home sector, then M overview.
evidence.measurements: 458 near / 174 far triangles, two resident S3TC image RIDs with mips totaling 3,495,280 bytes. Whole-view primitives +422/+138/+138, minus two draw calls in each lens. Controlled same-process software only: warm hero serial ABBA baseline 62.136/61.257 ms, candidate 68.545/71.274 ms; do not infer console or GPU FPS.

shape_and_craft.finding: Closed wood shutter supported by a visible frame, iron straps/latch, plinth and covered eave. Actual gameplay and both supplemental rear corners show joined plaster and wall seating; no measured positive-area duplicate surfaces.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Closed split timber, sandstone and worn ash plaster hold a distinct angle under the real lighting. The existing shape casts the same shadow with no additional source or shared map lighting changes.

readability_in_play.finding: The shutter reads at the actual hero approach without claiming an enterable doorway; roof and interaction site stay distinct in command. Twenty-two native distance probes choose one visual variant through the 48 m transition.

integration_and_cost.finding: Visual-only subtree. Original bodies, roof pick rejection, supported cart yard, two route choices and three arrivals unchanged. Same-process scene-relative cost is within this single kit's texture and primitive budget (less than 4 MiB; +500/+200/+200 maximum and no added draws). No target hardware benchmark.

motion_and_effects.reason: Static closed shell, no opening or animation. Actual hero movement, battle cameras, cart arrival and separate household motion were used for context.

tests: Actual lower yard hero boarding, cart at (-134,-4,41), three arrivals, wells remain inert, and roof cannot be ordered
